results.reader_what: A Commission-commissioned wiiw econometric report evaluates EU foreign investment, ICT capital and participation in global value chains.

results.reader_more: Adarov and Stehrer combine EU KLEMS capital-stock data, bilateral investment statistics and sector/country econometric models. These are historical associations and estimated relationships, not proof of a specific security risk or policy effectiveness.

results.reader_what: The European Commission approved approximately PLN 925.6 million of Polish state aid for building a Świnoujście liquefied-natural-gas import terminal.
results.reader_why: The approved aid supported plans to create a seaborne import route and reduce reliance on constrained pipeline-gas supply.
results.reader_more: The Global Trade Alert entry records a 5 October 2011 formal Commission aid approval. An original Polish competition-office communication corroborates the amount and purpose. This is permission to provide state aid, not proof that construction was complete on the decision date or that all planned diversification was realised.
